items.title: The modules admitting the standard cokernel presentation form a weak Serre subcategory under a hypothesis on kernels
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the quasi-compact objects situation the full subcategory A of modules isomorphic to a cokernel presentation by direct images j_{U!}O_U along basis members is a weak Serre subcategory, provided the kernel of every map between finite direct sums of such objects already lies in A. The proof uses the characterization criterion for weak Serre subcategories and the section's closure results for cokernels and extensions, reducing the verification to the kernel of a map between two objects of A; it then chooses presentations of both objects and refines them, so that the kernel can be exhibited as an object of A by the assumed hypothesis (proof lines 5690-5731). H2: the reduction chain to the single kernel case and the refinement of the two presentations are the substance, and the argument is written out.
